Description

Discover the perfect blend of recreation, privacy, and natural beauty on this exceptional 120 +/- acre hunting tract in Van Buren County, Arkansas!

A well-established trail system winds throughout the property, providing easy access for ATVs, hiking, hunting, and exploring. The land is covered with mature hardwoods and pine timber and features two wet-weather streams along with a larger tributary that enhances the property's beauty and provides an excellent wildlife corridor. 

The topography is outstanding, with much of the land being level to gently sloping, making the majority of the acreage highly usable. Multiple prime building sites offer the opportunity to create a hunting cabin, weekend retreat, or off-grid getaway.

Access is provided by an easement, ensuring peace and seclusion while remaining accessible. Whether you're looking for a premier hunting property, recreational escape, or long-term investment, this tract offers abundant wildlife, excellent timber, beautiful terrain, and endless possibilities. Don't miss your chance to own this incredible piece of the Ozarks! 

Experience this property before you ever set foot on it! Click the link below to ride along with us on an ATV and explore the property from the perspective of an actual tour. As you travel through the land, you'll get a true feel for the terrain, trails, views, and layout. For added convenience, you'll also notice an interactive map in the upper-right corner of the video that shows your exact location on the property throughout the ride, making it easy to understand how each feature is positioned. It's the next best thing to being there in person!  Click this link:  https://youtu.be/Uwa279sk2Us?si=86FkVXnG4ExZtPBz. 

Proudly listed with Mossy Oak Properties Selling Arkansas, 870-495-2123 .

Call or text Listing Agent and Local Land Specialist, Krystn Bourgeouis at 501-270-5276 for a tour and for more information.

Equal Housing Opportunity. www.WeSellArkansas.com.  No mineral rights will convey.  

Directions:

From Clinton, take Highway 16 West, go 14 miles and turn Left, go 0.6 mile and trail entrance will be on your left.

Showing Instructions:

Call or Text Krystn Bourgeois at 501-270-5276 .
